calls.source: generated from textual art direction derived from safe product references
calls.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one exceptional landscape 16:9 3D game-art scene for an original friendly robot factory game called BoltBots. This is a polished visual design reference for a Roblox game, not a technical diagram. It must look like a world a human would be excited to enter and play. NO text, NO UI, NO logos or watermark.
Scene: a compact sunlit futuristic assembly workshop in a large airy industrial atrium. A clearly coherent modular production line carries small friendly robots from parts bins through a sculptural assembler with amber robotic arms to a tidy packaging station. A distinctive hero Scout robot in the foreground: warm-white smooth beveled shell, cyan joint accents, glossy dark navy face visor with two expressive cyan eyes, chunky short legs and articulated rounded hands, slightly curious welcoming pose. Other smaller Scouts on the conveyor make production feel alive. Strong shape design rather than generic cubes.
Camera: inviting three-quarter gameplay perspective, moderately elevated, wide composition with real depth and a readable focal area around the assembler and hero robot in the central 60 percent; generous image coverage, not a floating isolated diorama. Leave the top edge and outer corners relatively calm for later separately drawn interface overlays; important characters fully inside frame. The real workshop fills the whole image.
Art direction: high-quality stylized 3D, collectible designer-toy charm, sophisticated rounded hard-surface modeling, broad bevels, carefully designed industrial props, coordinated shapes. Rich physically plausible lighting, soft contact shadows, subtle ambient occlusion, warm daylight from tall windows, cyan energized belt trims, a few warm amber details, pale painted polymer, navy metal framing, brushed metal joints. Controlled glossy reflections on visors and painted shells, elegant matte surfaces elsewhere. Beautiful warm/cool balance, crisp focal character and machine, no excessive bloom. Clear spacious workshop, restrained detail, clean production flow, believable modular pieces that could be modeled for a game. Blue sky and distant futuristic structures through windows.
Absolutely avoid flat vector art, infographic diagrams, UI-dashboard composition, low-effort primitive geometry, toy clipart, photorealistic grime, weapons, scary faces, crowded random machinery, exaggerated cinematic effects, known franchise characters, numerical badges and any baked-in writing. This should feel premium, tactile, cohesive and genuinely delightful, with character appeal and excellent art direction.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a premium 3D character collection sheet for the original robot factory game BoltBots, with a genuinely transparent background. Exactly FIVE whole-body collectible robots in one horizontal row, one centered in each equal-width column, generous clear spacing; none overlap or touch image boundaries. No text, no labels, no UI, no logo, no floor/background panel.
Consistent designer-toy universe: rounded hard-surface shells, generous sculpted bevels, tasteful dark metal joints, glossy navy face visors, two expressive luminous eyes, charming short-limbed proportions and distinct curious poses, refined soft studio illumination, subtle surface highlights. They must look like desirable game characters, not simple color-swapped generic cubes.
Left to right:
1 SCOUT: warm ivory/white rounded square helmet, cyan trims and eyes, stout compact body, short antenna, one friendly open articulated hand. Approachable original starter mascot.
2 ORBIT: elegant lavender/white compact spherical helmet, a thin asymmetric orbit ring encircling upper helmet, violet eyes, rounded feet, inquisitive posture. Distinct sophisticated silhouette.
3 BOLT: amber-orange angular but friendly helmet, a small lightning-shaped crest, compact athletic body, dark articulated gloves, energetic poised stance.
4 LUMA: coral-peach and pearl shell, softly luminous petal-like side sensor fins, bright friendly eyes, slim gracefully rounded body and open hands.
5 ATLAS: mint/teal and navy heavy broad shoulders, robust barrel chest, large rounded forearms, short sturdy feet, calm protective character, still cute.
Cohesive professional stylized 3D game art with real depth, convincing materials and beautiful tactile modeling. Full bodies at similar screen height, balanced silhouette/spacing so each occupies its own fifth of the canvas. No weapons, no copied franchise mascots, no photoreal humans, no flat vector illustration. Highest attention to silhouette appeal and the desire to collect each one.

calls.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Refine this existing five-robot 3D collection sheet for use as separate UI character portraits. Preserve the exact five character identities, colors, facial expressions, left-to-right order, full bodies, professional dimensional materials and appealing studio lighting.
Change the layout: exactly five equal-width columns with each robot fully contained in the CENTER 70 percent of its own column. Leave at least 15 percent of each column completely transparent on both its left and right edge. Absolutely no part of any robot, orbit ring, antenna, hand, glow or shadow may enter an adjacent column. Keep at least 7 percent transparent margin above and below the full figures. Maintain similar full-body screen height for all five. Make the alpha boundary clean and naturally antialiased, with NO white fringe, white halos, detached pixels or segmentation residue.
Output one wide horizontal transparent PNG sheet, exactly these five original robots, no labels/text/UI/background/floor. Preserve transparency. This is a careful production-cleanup and spacing edit, not a new character design.

calls.source: new opaque navy studio rendering to avoid extraction artifacts
calls.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a BRAND NEW production-quality wide 3D character portrait sheet for original game BoltBots. OPAQUE dark navy studio background, exact color #101B35, NOT transparent, NOT a cutout, no chroma key, no extraction edges. The characters must be smoothly rendered against the original dark background with natural clean lighting, not pasted on it.
Layout: exactly FIVE equal-width vertical portrait spaces across one wide horizontal image. Every figure entirely inside its own fifth, including hands, antenna, ring and feet. Scale each character to fit with very generous empty side margins in its own portrait space, prioritizing NO OVERLAP over equal character height. At least 20% empty width on either side of each figure within its space. No visible panel borders or separators; a single consistent navy background. Entire bodies and accessories visible with room above and below. No text, no name labels, no UI, no logos, no floor podiums.
The five original designer-toy robots, left to right:
SCOUT: ivory white shell, cyan trims, big glossy dark navy round-rectangular face with two cheerful cyan eyes, compact short-limbed body, subtle little antenna, curious friendly wave.
ORBIT: pearlescent lavender and white, rounded head with a thin elegant tilted orbital ring, luminous violet eyes, thoughtful tilted head and relaxed hands.
BOLT: warm amber orange with ivory panels, small lightning-shaped crest, amber friendly eyes, energetic compact body and rounded dark gloves.
LUMA: pearl and coral-peach with petal-shaped side sensor fins, softly glowing peach eyes, elegant small rounded limbs, welcoming open hands.
ATLAS: mint teal and navy with ivory chestplate, very broad rounded shoulders and sturdy body, oversized rounded forearms, short legs, kind cyan eyes.
All five belong to one premium stylized 3D game universe: masterful hard-surface toy modeling, wide sculptural bevels, controlled glossy reflections, rich materials, well-designed joints, expressive poses. Strongly appealing and collectible, original character identities. Excellent studio lighting carefully balanced for navy background, subtle cyan/amber rim lights without halos. Clean smooth edges everywhere. NO white/frayed outlines, NO detached pixels, NO busy background, NO flat vectors, NO duplicated color swaps, NO cut-off parts. Each portrait has clear breathing room and looks complete by itself. Create a cohesive charming result that people would want to collect and play.
